executor_calibration.gate: v0.3 at least 15/16 task successes, finish-only both repetitions correct; otherwise record failed gate and diagnose on calibration only

ablations.interpretation: exploratory information deletion; overlapping fields may reconstruct deleted information; representation budget errors count as failures

reporting: no hidden rubric in model inputs
no silent output repair or full-history fallback
API failure stops run and suppresses incomplete performance
important_result_policy: Immediately report evidence that changes interpretation, positive or negative; never tune heldout tasks to obtain CS wins
limits: small synthetic exploratory suite, no independent researcher validation or significance claims
